claim.value: Exposed exports that remain unfinished must be explicitly censored.
claim.scope: Endpoint and follow-up handling; following exposed exports to completion is qualified by feasibility.

provenance.rationale: P017 directly specifies explicit censoring of unfinished exports and qualifies completion follow-up by feasibility.

signal_basis.value: Some exposed exports remain unfinished when their available follow-up ends, while time-to-completion estimates must include unfinished exports.
signal_basis.scope: Handling incomplete completion times after the planned endpoint and feasible follow-up; the measurements are proposed and their occurrence is assumed for this judgment.

provenance.rationale: P017 supplies the endpoint, feasible follow-up, and unfinished-export condition; P021 requires completion-time estimates to include unfinished exports. P025 establishes that these are proposed measurements.
The claim is supported without an unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: An export still unfinished at the end of its observed follow-up has an unknown completion time exceeding its observed elapsed time. Explicit censoring faithfully represents that incomplete observation and supports including it in completion-time analysis. This licenses the specified handling within its feasibility qualification.
uncertainty: Censoring records incomplete outcomes; it does not by itself guarantee unbiased completion-time estimates.
